project.description:
The reading library: six bodies of text, one module each, plus a root that arranges them.
A SEPARATE REPOSITORY because it releases on a different clock from the reader. The application changes when a gesture or a pane changes; this changes when somebody writes an article. Neither should have to wait for the other, and a content change should not rebuild a front end.
DISCOVERED, NOT DEPENDED ON. The reader has no compile-time knowledge of anything here: it asks the classpath, through META-INF/services/kranji.reading.library.ArticleLibrary, and mounts the root it finds. So the deployment is two jars side by side, and a deployment that wants a different library swaps one of them.
ONE MODULE PER GROUP because a collection is the unit of curation, review and licensing, and a group is the unit of authorship. 古诗词 is public-domain verse a thousand years old; 科普读物 is written for this project; 笑话 is the group most likely to be replaced wholesale when somebody decides the jokes are not funny. A build that wants three of the six should be able to say so in three lines, and a licence claim should be answerable per group rather than for a heap.
Each module owns its own catalogue - the tree shape as well as the collections - because how 唐诗 divides by era, author and form is a judgement about 唐诗 and belongs beside it. kranji-library-all does nothing but stack them.
